title: cli-surface.md's lore init flag row never gained --preserve-source-ids / --source-family
description:
Found during LCLI-466's implementation review, outside its acceptance criteria and filed rather than folded in.

LCLI-465 shipped --preserve-source-ids and --source-family and documented them in src/core/manifest.ts's help text, but the 'Key flags' row for lore init in docs/reference/cli-surface.md still omits both. LCLI-466 added a prose paragraph to the same file's wizard section that NAMES the flags, so the page now describes them in prose while its own flag table stays incomplete -- which is worse than a uniform omission, because the table reads as authoritative and now visibly disagrees with the text above it.

Small documentation fix. Drive it through lore, not a plain editor.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/reference/cli-surface.md lists both --preserve-source-ids and --source-family in the `lore init` Key flags row, consistent with src/core/manifest.ts and the line-188 prose, and `lore check` exits 0 on the change.

plan: 1. Claim LCLI-518 and branch docs/LCLI-518-cli-surface-init-flags from origin/dev.
2. Run the packaged opum-workflow:document-assignment Workflow to add both flags to the init Key flags row in docs/reference/cli-surface.md, inside a docs allow-list, ending on a green lore check.
3. Independent read-only check: opum-workflow:review-assignment on the documenter commit 014419ff.
4. Push, open the PR to dev, wait for required checks green on the exact head, squash-merge, complete the task, delete the local branch.
implementationNotes: Added --preserve-source-ids and --source-family to the `lore init` Key flags row in docs/reference/cli-surface.md, matching the wizard prose at line 188 and src/core/manifest.ts; the row no longer contradicts the text above it.

Documenter commit 014419ff on branch docs/LCLI-518-cli-surface-init-flags, base 46662f355c0648cd52abf386b7e7ba0740ad09f7. Gates green on the frozen head: `lore check` and `bun run lore check` each exit 0 (89 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings).

Independent review (opum-workflow:review-assignment, run wf_8f630603-a26) verdict approve, 0 findings. Full `bun test` on the pinned bun 1.4.2: 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail -- the one fail is the pre-existing LCLI-614/LCLI-645 SF1 red, unreachable from a docs-only diff; under PATH bun 1.3.14 the LCLI-648 runtime-floor test also reds by design.
docs/log.md also carries lore sync regeneration (7 log entries for commits landed since the last sync), inside the allow-list.
finalSummary: Closed LCLI-518: the `lore init` Key flags row in docs/reference/cli-surface.md now lists --preserve-source-ids and --source-family, matching the wizard prose above it and the authoritative definitions in src/core/manifest.ts, so the row no longer contradicts the text on the page. Delivered by the packaged opum-workflow:document-assignment Workflow (run wf_b9c4421a-2bc, outcome pass; documenter commit 014419ff) and independently reviewed by opum-workflow:review-assignment (run wf_8f630603-a26, verdict approve, 0 findings). Verified: `lore check` and `bun run lore check` exit 0; full `bun test` on the pinned bun 1.4.2 is 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail -- the one fail is the pre-existing LCLI-614/LCLI-645 SF1 red, unreachable from a docs-only diff; and PR opum-ai/lore-cli#490 required checks are green on head 8a1dd6d5 (CI run 37367561609).
